title: Product Manager 46-50HP
description:
**About Us**
At CNH, we're driven by a clear purpose:
**we serve and advance the people who feed and build a growing world.**
As a global leader in agriculture and construction, we create the equipment, technology, and solutions that help our customers work more productively and sustainably. Our success starts with our people, and we foster a collaborative culture where innovation thrives and every employee has the opportunity to grow.
  
  
**Grow a Career. Build a Future.**
If you're ready to make an impact and build a career with purpose, there's a place for you at CNH.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Product Manager – 46-50 HP is responsible for managing the complete product portfolio within the 46-50 HP tractor segment throughout its lifecycle. The role drives product strategy, portfolio planning, market competitiveness, pricing, product launches, and business growth by collaborating with cross-functional teams including Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, R&D, and Global Product Management. The incumbent serves as the business owner for the assigned product range, ensuring alignment with customer needs, dealer expectations, and the company's strategic objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Develop and execute product strategies while managing the complete lifecycle of the
**46-50**
**HP tractor portfolio**
, from product planning to phase-out.
  
  
Conduct market research, customer and competitor analysis to identify market opportunities, product gaps, and drive portfolio competitiveness.
  
  
Gather customer, dealer, and sales feedback to recommend product improvements and support future product development initiatives.
  
  
Develop annual business plans, demand forecasts, pricing strategies, and profitability plans to achieve sales and market share objectives.
  
  
Lead new product development and launch activities in collaboration with Engineering, R&D, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and Global Product teams.
  
  
Develop product positioning, value propositions, technical literature, and marketing collateral to support successful product commercialization.
  
  
Conduct technical and commercial training for sales teams and dealers, while supporting product demonstrations, exhibitions, and customer engagement activities.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Sales, Service, Supply Chain, Finance, and Marketing to ensure effective product execution and business growth.
  
  
Monitor product performance, market trends, inventory, profitability, and key business metrics, recommending corrective actions where required.
  
  
Prepare management reports, ensure compliance with company policies and quality standards, and drive continuous product improvement through market insights and innovation.
  
  
**Experience Required**
10-15 Yrs
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Agricultural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Business Management, or Agri-Business is preferred.
  
  
Strong technical understanding of tractors, agricultural machinery, implements, and farming applications, particularly in the
**46-50**
**HP**
segment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.
  
  
**Benefits**
At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements
* Savings & Retirement benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* Parental leave
* Adoption assistance
* Fertility & Family building support
* Employee Assistance Programs
* Charitable contribution matching and Volunteer Time Off

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Arrabi merges contemporary design with timeless craftsmanship, creating products that reflect a blend of heritage and modern living. Known for its high-quality Home Furnishings, Elegant Crockery, and thoughtfully designed Apparel, the brand celebrates rich textures, colors, and cultural artistry. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, Arrabi makes everyday luxury accessible to all.

Its specialties span E-commerce, Quick Commerce, B2B, sourcing, and gifting to cater to diverse customer demands.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role for an Ecommerce Manager based in Hapur, UP. We are seeking an experienced E-commerce Manager to lead and manage our online sales and B2B sales activities. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing and implementing successful ecommerce strategies, driving revenue growth, and optimizing the online customer experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee the operation and maintenance of our e-commerce platform on Amazon, Myntra, Ajio, Flipkart & other platforms.
* Monitor and analyze website performance, user behavior, and sales data to optimize the platform.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive e-commerce strategy aligned with business goals in order to boost online sales.
* B2B Sales and Business Growth
* Identify opportunities to enhance the online shopping experience for customers.
* Ensure accurate and engaging product listings.
* Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns.
* Manage claim settlement.
* Address customer feedback and implement improvements based on user behavior and preferences.

**Qualifications/Key Skills:**

* Minimum experience of 6 years or more as an E-commerce Manager or in a similar role.
* In-depth knowledge of e-commerce platforms, technologies, and trends.
* Experience in managing Amazon, Ajio, Flipkart and Myntra.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Team management and leadership skills.

🛒 Platforms: Myntra | Amazon | Flipkart | AJIO | Quick Commerce (Blinkit / Zepto)

📍 Location: Hapur, Uttar Pradesh (On-site)

💼 Experience: 6+ years

💰 Salary: Fully flexible based on experience

✅ Key Skills:

* Business Growth
* B2B and offline sales
* Marketplace analytics & growth strategy
* Increase sales
* Team management
* Claims Settlement
* Cataloging & listings optimization
* Ads & campaign management
* Inventory & returns handling

title: Product Manager Combine Harvesters
description:
